_meta.method: web research against primary sources (official drawings, ISO tables, vendor tables); see source_urls per entry

raspberry_pi_5.name: Raspberry Pi 5
raspberry_pi_5.confidence: high (outline/holes/connectors from official drawing); corner radius & thickness not on Pi 5 drawing
raspberry_pi_5.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 85 mm long edge, Y along 56 mm edge; GPIO header along top edge (Y=56); USB/Ethernet on right short edge (X=85); power/HDMI on bottom long edge (Y=0)

connectors.name: Left-edge feature (likely LED light-pipe; identity not labelled)

raspberry_pi_5.notes: Drawing labels mounting holes ø2.7; HAT spec says M2.5 drilled 2.75±0.05. Corner R3.0 from Pi 4/3B+ drawings + HAT spec (same B form factor), not stated on Pi 5 drawing. GPIO header centre = 29 mm right of left hole (X=32.5) on hole line Y=52.5; pin 1 at approx (8.37, 51.23). 4-pin PoE header centred 6 mm above bottom-right hole (61.5, 9.5). USB/Ethernet overhang right PCB edge by ~3 mm (side view). microSD on left edge, protrudes. PCB thickness and component heights not given on drawing (use 1.6 / ~16 mm USB stack, verify with calipers).

connectors.name: CSI camera FFC (on board, not edge)

raspberry_pi_4b.notes: Drawing chain: hole 3.5 + 7.7 = USB-C 11.2; +14.8 = HDMI0 26.0; +13.5 = HDMI1 39.5; +7 = CSI 46.5; +7.5 = audio 54.0. Hole ø2.7 with ø6 land. Corner radius 3.0 stated. raspberry_pi_zero_2_w.name: Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W
raspberry_pi_zero_2_w.confidence: high for outline/hole centres/connectors; hole diameter & corner radius not on drawing
raspberry_pi_zero_2_w.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 65 mm edge, GPIO header along top edge (Y=30), mini-HDMI/USB on bottom edge (Y=0), microSD on left short edge, CSI on right short edge
raspberry_pi_zero_2_w.notes: Hole pattern 58 x 23 confirmed (3.5 from each edge). raspberry_pi_pico.name: Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040, Rev3)
raspberry_pi_pico.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 51 mm long edge with micro-USB end at X=0, Y along 21 mm edge (datasheet figure is rotated 90 deg: USB at top)
raspberry_pi_pico.notes: Datasheet: 51x21 mm, 1 mm thick PCB, 4x 2.1 mm (±0.05) drilled holes, holes 11.4 apart across width (4.8 from long edges) and 2.0 from each short edge (47.0 pattern). Pin rows 17.78 apart, 1.61 from long edges; 20 pins/row spanning 48.26, first pin ~1.37 from short edge. Micro-USB overhangs the short edge by 1.3 mm (typ). Single-sided PCB (components on top only). Corner radius not dimensioned (small).

raspberry_pi_pico_w.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 51 mm long edge with micro-USB end at X=0, Y along 21 mm edge (datasheet figure is rotated 90 deg: USB at top)
raspberry_pi_pico_w.notes: Datasheet: 51x21 mm, 1 mm thick PCB, 4x 2.1 mm (±0.05) drilled holes, holes 11.4 apart across width (4.8 from long edges) and 2.0 from each short edge (47.0 pattern). Pin rows 17.78 apart, 1.61 from long edges; 20 pins/row spanning 48.26, first pin ~1.37 from short edge. Micro-USB overhangs the short edge by 1.3 mm (typ). Single-sided PCB (components on top only). arduino_uno_r3.name: Arduino Uno Rev3
arduino_uno_r3.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along long edge; USB-B and DC jack on left short edge (X=0, USB-B upper, DC jack lower); digital header along top edge (Y=53.34); power/analog header along bottom edge
arduino_uno_r3.notes: Datasheet sec 5.4: 4x ø3.20 (126 mil); top-left hole 15.24 from left/2.54 from top; right holes at X=66.04, 17.78 and 45.72 below top edge; bottom-left hole 50.80 below top (X=13.97 from outline/Eagle, consistent with drawing scale). Board 2700x2100 mil = 68.58x53.34 (store rounds to 68.6x53.4). Right end has angled corners/notch, not a simple radius. USB-B and DC jack overhang left edge (not dimensioned). PCB thickness not stated.

arduino_uno_r4.name: Arduino Uno R4 Minima / R4 WiFi
arduino_uno_r4.origin_convention: same as arduino_uno_r3 (USB-C + DC jack on left edge, digital header on top edge)
arduino_uno_r4.notes: Footprint CONFIRMED identical to R3: 68.58x53.34, 4x R1.6 holes at same coordinates (right holes 2.54 from right edge, 17.78 from top / 7.62 from bottom). Right-hand corners are 2x 3.6 mm x 45 deg chamfers. Side view: '1 mm' appears to be PCB thickness (verify by caliper, R3 is commonly 1.6), USB-C 3 mm tall, tallest part 8.5 mm. 'center' for USB-C entry above is its height, not an offset.

arduino_nano.name: Arduino Nano (classic, ATmega328)
arduino_nano.confidence: high for holes/pitch; medium for hole edge offsets (derived by centring)
arduino_nano.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 43.2 mm long edge, mini-USB at right end (X=43.2)
arduino_nano.notes: Draft 18x45 -> PCB 43.2x18 (45 mm is Arduino marketing length incl. mini-USB overhang). 4x ø1.8 holes, pattern 40.64 x 15.24, assumed centred on PCB. Header rows 15.24 (0.6 in) apart, 2.54 pitch, 15 pins each; 6-pin ICSP 2x3 at the non-USB end. PCB 1.6 mm. Side view: overall 18.6 mm incl. headers, 2.5 mm dimension below PCB (header plastic).

arduino_mega_2560_r3.name: Arduino Mega 2560 Rev3
arduino_mega_2560_r3.confidence: medium-high (datasheet drawing is coarse: 99x53 overall, ø3; coordinates match Eagle-standard values when scaled)
arduino_mega_2560_r3.origin_convention: same as arduino_uno_r3 (USB-B + DC jack on left edge, X along 101.52 mm edge)
arduino_mega_2560_r3.notes: 6 holes. Datasheet fig 6.1 labels holes ø3mm, 75 mm between the two top holes (15.24->90.17), 53 mm width, 99 mm to chamfer line; store spec 101.52 x 53.3 mm. Pixel-measured hole centres agree with listed coordinates within ~0.2 mm. Uno-compatible subset: first 4 holes. Two small ø2 features near left edge in fig 6.1 are not mounting holes. Right end stepped/chamfered.

esp32_devkitc_v4.name: Espressif ESP32-DevKitC V4 (WROOM-32 variant)
esp32_devkitc_v4.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 48.26 mm long edge with micro-USB end at X=0, antenna end at X=48.26
esp32_devkitc_v4.notes: NO mounting holes. Header rows 25.40 mm apart (1.30 drawn from pin to edge; 27.94-25.40 gives 1.27), 2.54 pitch, 19 pins/row; first pin 1.29 from USB end. Module antenna overhangs the far short edge by 6.04 mm (module 18.00 wide) -> overall length ~54.3 mm. Micro-USB centred on width (by drawing). Some variants (WROVER) differ; drawing is WROOM-32.

esp32_s3_devkitc_1.name: Espressif ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 v1.1

esp32_s3_devkitc_1.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, component side up, X along 62.74 mm long edge with the two USB ports at X=0, antenna end at X=62.74

connectors.name: USB (UART bridge) + USB (native) ports, two micro-USB/USB-C depending on batch

esp32_s3_devkitc_1.notes: NO mounting holes. Row spacing 22.86 mm (25.40 - 2x1.27). Last pin centre 8.00 from USB end; first pin ~1.40 from antenna end (62.74-53.34-8.00). rpi_camera_module_3.name: Raspberry Pi Camera Module 3 (standard)
rpi_camera_module_3.confidence: high for outline/holes/lens; medium for depth stack
rpi_camera_module_3.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, viewed from lens side, X along 25 mm edge, Y along 23.862 mm edge, FFC/ribbon connector on the top edge (Y=23.862); holes near bottom edge are the ones 2.0 mm from the edge opposite the connector
rpi_camera_module_3.notes: Draft 25x24 -> 25 x 23.862. Holes ø2.2, 21 x 12.5 pattern confirmed; ø4.75 land/keepout around holes. Lens centre X=12.5, Y=14.4 (nearly in line with the hole pair at Y=14.5). Lens housing 10.8 square. Side view: overall depth 11.3 (lens tip to back of connector), other dims 6.98/3.875/2.75, connector block 5.71; '1.12' likely PCB thickness - verify. Corner radius 2.0 from v2 drawing (CM3 drawing shows same rounded corners but no callout). FOV 66 deg H / 41 deg V.

rpi_camera_module_v2.origin_convention: origin = bottom-left PCB corner, viewed from lens side, X along 25 mm edge, Y along 23.862 mm edge, FFC/ribbon connector on the top edge (Y=23.862); holes near bottom edge are the ones 2.0 mm from the edge opposite the connector
rpi_camera_module_v2.notes: Drawing: 4x 2.2 mm holes, 4x 2.0 mm radius corners, 25 x 23.862. Holes 2 mm from edges, second pair 14.5 from edge opposite connector.
